entries.name: documents-publication-audit
entries.claim: Every published version is accounted for by a committed attachment audit row.
entries.original:
await client.query(
              `INSERT INTO platform.document_attachment_audit (tenant_id, environment_id, link_id, operation_id)
         VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)`,
              [
                view.tenantId,
                view.environmentId,
                linkId,
                generated
                  ? documentGenerateOperation(record.entity.entityId)
                  : documentAttachOperation(record.entity.entityId),
              ],
            );
